stemMd:
n is an integer.

Quantity A: $2^{n+2}$

Quantity B: $4(2^n)$
instructionsMd: Compare the two quantities using only the given information.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The relationship cannot be determined from the information given.

explanationMd: The exponent rule gives 2 to the power n+2=(2 to the power n) times 2 squared. This is exactly the second quantity for all integer n.
